text:
Maya: quick sync on embeddings preview page - customer wants a density toggle (dense/compact) and clearer export formats.
Ravi: compact should collapse full vectors and show a top-3 dims summary. dense renders vectors inline but lazy-loads.
Tess: For export, make formats explicit: 'CSV (summary)' and 'JSONL (full)'. Customers kept getting a JSON when they expected CSV.
Omar: We currently copy only visible rows when virtualization is on. That's confusing. Copy/export should operate on the selected set, not viewport.
Priya: Agree. Also for CSV snippet column, truncate to 200 chars and label it 'text_snippet' to avoid leaking full content.
a11y-bot: Use explicit button labels: 'Copy CSV (summary)' and 'Download JSONL (full)'. Add aria-live region announcing "Copied N rows". Ensure contrast for badges.
Maya: Where to place export CTA? Left with filters or right with actions? My thought: right cluster for actions, left for stateful controls.
Ravi: Right cluster OK, but compress into kebab on small screens. Add sticky density toggle in toolbar.
Tess: Sorting: in rerank views default to relevance_score desc and show helper text 'Reranked: sorted by relevance'. Persist per-user.
Omar: Backend needs an estimate endpoint for export size so UI can show "~4.2MB". Also add mask_text flag for PII masking.
Priya: Keyboard: ensure export menu is reachable via keyboard, shortcut Ctrl+Shift+E to open modal. Avoid long-press patterns.
a11y-bot: For delta badges use icon+text and aria-labels like 'moved up 3 positions'. Maintain contrast >=4.5:1 for small text.
Maya: Action items: Ravi - toolbar + mobile collapse; Omar - export size API + mask flag; Tess - default sort + helper text; Priya - a11y checks. I'll put together copy and mock and open PR.
Ravi: I'll prototype the compact/dense toggle and lazy render.
Omar: I'll draft API contract for size estimate.
Priya: I'll prepare the a11y checklist and run a quick screen reader pass when the PR is up.
Maya: thanks all, I'll attach mocks and sample copy in the PR later today.
